title: Clean and decorate
description: Clean the home, make rangoli at the entrance, hang toran of mango leaves and marigold, keep diyas ready.

title: Fix the muhurat
description: Check the Lakshmi Puja Muhurat (Pradosh Kaal with Sthir Lagna) for your city.

title: Set up the puja chowki
description: Spread a red cloth on a chowki, place Lakshmi-Ganesh idols, install a kalash with mango leaves and a coconut, and keep silver coins and account books nearby.

title: Sankalp and Ganesh puja
description: Take sankalp with water and rice, invoke Ganesha first with roli, akshat, durva and modak.

title: Lakshmi puja
description: Offer panchamrit, kumkum, lotus, khil-batasha and sweets to Lakshmi; chant Shri Suktam or Lakshmi mantras; also worship Kuber and Saraswati.

title: Aarti
description: Perform aarti with a ghee diya and camphor, ring the bell and distribute prasad.

title: Light diyas
description: Light diyas at the main door, courtyard, kitchen and windows; share sweets with family and neighbours.

title: Chopda pujan (business)
description: Traders worship account books and cash box and open new ledgers.

title: Buy something new
description: Buy gold, silver, a new utensil or broom during the day; avoid iron/black items by local custom.

title: Dhanvantari and Lakshmi puja
description: In Pradosh Kaal place Dhanvantari, Lakshmi-Ganesh and Kuber; offer flowers, dhaniya-gud, sweets.

title: Light a Yamadeep
description: After sunset light a four-faced oil diya outside the main door facing south for Yama to protect from untimely death.

title: Lamp tradition
description: Keep 13 diyas lit around the home as many families do on Dhanteras night.

title: Abhyang snan
description: Before sunrise apply ubtan and til oil, then bathe; this is said to remove sins and bring health.

title: Worship Yama and Krishna
description: Offer lamps to Yama, remember Krishna's victory over Narakasura, and in Gujarat/Bengal worship Kali or Hanuman at night.

title: Evening diyas
description: Light many diyas at home at dusk, a start of the Diwali lighting.

title: Make the Govardhan figure
description: Make a reclining Govardhan mountain from cow dung in the courtyard and decorate with flowers.

title: Worship
description: Offer roli, akshat, kheer, dahi and Annakut (a mountain of cooked food), then circumambulate the figure.

title: Cow puja
description: Bathe and decorate cows, feed them and worship them.

title: Share Annakut
description: Distribute the Annakut prasad among family and the neighbourhood.

title: Prepare tilak thali
description: Sister prepares a thali with roli, akshat, a lamp, sweets and a coconut gola.

title: Tilak and aarti
description: Sister applies tilak, performs aarti of the brother, and feeds him sweets and mishri.

title: Gifts and promise
description: Brother gives a gift and promises to protect and support her.

title: Sargi
description: Before sunrise eat the sargi prepared by the mother-in-law (fruits, dry fruits, mathri, sweets) and drink water.

title: Nirjala fast
description: Observe the fast without water and food through the day; get ready with solah shringar by evening.

title: Karwa puja and katha
description: In the evening gather with other women, worship Shiva-Parvati and Ganesha, exchange karwa and listen to the Karwa Chauth katha.

title: Moon arghya
description: After moonrise view the moon through a sieve, offer water in a lota, then look at the husband through the sieve.

title: Break the fast
description: Husband offers the first sip of water and first bite of food; eat dinner together.

title: Ahoi Mata image
description: Draw Ahoi Mata with her cubs on the wall or place a printed picture and silver Ahoi pendant.

title: Evening puja and katha
description: At dusk offer roli, akshat, halwa-puri and listen to the Ahoi Ashtami katha.

title: Break the fast
description: After sighting stars (or the moon in some traditions) offer arghya and break the fast; give the pendant a thread of 'moli'.

title: Day 1: Nahay-Khay
description: Bathe in a river or clean water, cook a pure meal of kaddu (bottle gourd), chana dal and rice and eat once.

title: Day 2: Kharna
description: Fast all day; in the evening eat kheer, roti and fruit prasad; then the 36-hour nirjala fast starts.

title: Day 3: Sandhya Arghya
description: Go to the river or pond bank, stand in water and offer arghya to the setting Sun with fruits, thekua and bamboo soop.

title: Day 4: Usha Arghya
description: Before sunrise offer arghya to the rising Sun and break the fast with prasad (parana).

title: Make the courtyard design
description: Draw Vishnu's footprints or a rangoli in the courtyard with rice paste and place a sugarcane mandap.

title: Fast and Vishnu puja
description: Offer tulsi, fruits, singhara, sugarcane and panchamrit to Vishnu.

title: Wake the God
description: Ring bells and chant 'Uthho Dev, baitho Dev, angurhiyan chatkao Dev'.

title: Parana
description: Break the fast the next morning during the Parana window.

title: Decorate Tulsi
description: Tulsi plant is decorated with a chunri, bindi, bangles and a sugarcane mandap.

title: Shaligram on a chowki
description: Keep a Shaligram or Vishnu image on a chowki as the bridegroom.

title: Vivah ritual
description: Perform kanyadaan, haldi, sindoor and pheras around Tulsi chanting mangalashtak, then aarti.

title: Prasad
description: Distribute sweets and amla; the wedding season begins.

title: Ghatasthapana setup
description: Clean the puja space, set a kalash with Ganga water, mango leaves and coconut, and sow barley (jwara) in a pot.

title: Day 1: Shailputri
description: Install Ghat at the muhurat, light Akhand Jyot, offer ghee and pure white flowers.

title: Days 2-9: nine forms
description: Worship the nine forms daily: Shailputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayani, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, Siddhidatri.

title: Durga Saptashati path
description: Read the Durga Saptashati or Devi Mahatmya and chant Navarna mantra.

title: Ashtami or Navami: havan and kanya pujan
description: Feed nine girls and a boy, wash their feet, offer halwa-puri-chana and gifts; perform a small havan.

title: Visarjan
description: Immerse the idols or Ghat jwara after Dashami puja.

title: Sandhi puja
description: Perform special Sandhi Puja at the transition of Ashtami into Navami with 108 diyas and lotus.

title: Kanya pujan
description: Invite nine girls, wash feet, tilak, feed halwa-puri-chana, give chunri and a small gift.

title: Havan
description: Perform Durga havan with ghee, havan samagri and a coconut purnahuti.

title: Shastra pujan
description: Clean and worship weapons, tools, books and vehicles with roli, flowers and sweets.

title: Aparajita and Shami puja
description: Worship Aparajita Devi and Shami tree, take Shami leaves ('sona') and give to elders.

title: Ravan Dahan
description: At dusk watch the Ramlila culmination and burning of Ravana, Kumbhakarna and Meghnad effigies.

title: Greet and eat
description: Greet elders, exchange Shami leaves and eat jalebi/fafda or sweets.

title: Prepare kheer
description: Prepare kheer of milk, rice and sugar with dry fruits and keep it covered in a thin cloth.

title: Moon and Lakshmi puja
description: After moonrise worship the moon with roli, rice and flowers and perform Lakshmi puja.

title: Kheer in moonlight
description: Keep the kheer in an open place in moonlight for several hours.

title: Prasad
description: Eat the kheer as prasad after midnight or next morning.

title: Bring the idol
description: Bring home an eco-friendly clay Ganesha, preferably facing east or north, on a decorated chowki.

title: Pranpratishtha
description: Install the idol with invocation (Avahan), offer a seat and wash the idol's feet symbolically.

title: Shodashopachar puja
description: Offer 16 upacharas: flowers, 21 durva, red hibiscus, sindoor, janeu, 21 modak, coconut; chant Atharvashirsha or Vakratunda mantra.

title: Daily aarti
description: Do morning and evening aarti with modak and fruits for 1.5, 3, 5, 7 or 10 days.

title: Visarjan
description: On the chosen day perform uttar puja and immerse the idol in a tank or artificial pond, chanting 'Ganpati Bappa Morya'.

title: Anant puja
description: Worship Lord Anant (Vishnu) with a kalash and tie a 14-knot Anant sutra on the right wrist (men) or left wrist (women).

title: Ganesh visarjan
description: Take a procession and immerse Ganesha idols in water bodies.

title: Find the tithi
description: Use the Panchang to find the tithi on which the ancestor passed; for an unknown date use Sarva Pitru Amavasya.

title: Tarpan
description: Face south, sit on Kusha asana and offer water mixed with black sesame, barley and flowers to ancestors, reciting their names and gotra.

title: Pind daan and shraddh
description: Offer pind (balls of rice/barley, sesame, honey) with a pandit's guidance and perform shraddh.

title: Panchabali
description: Set aside food for a cow, dog, crow, ants and gods; then feed Brahmins and give dakshina.

title: Charity
description: Donate clothes, grain, umbrellas and food in the names of ancestors.

title: Build the Holika pyre
description: In the locality build a pyre of wood and cow-dung cakes with the Holika-Prahlad effigy, a few days before.

title: Puja
description: At the muhurat worship Holika with roli, akshat, flowers, raw thread and water, circumambulate three or seven times.

title: Lighting
description: Light the pyre, offer coconuts, new wheat/gram ears and sweets to the fire.

title: Ash and prasad
description: Take a bit of ash or roasted grain home as prasad and apply the ash as tilak.

title: Morning colours
description: Begin with a puja to Krishna-Radha or Narasimha and apply light tilak of gulal to elders.

title: Playing Holi
description: Play with dry colours and water with family and friends, with singing and dancing to Phag songs.

title: Evening meet
description: Wash up, wear new clothes, visit relatives and neighbours with gujiya and sweets.

title: Cook the day before
description: Prepare all food (rabri, dahi, roti, pua) on Saptami evening; no fire on Ashtami.

title: Sheetla puja
description: At dawn visit the Sheetla Mata temple or puja corner and offer haldi, roli, water, neem leaves and the cold food.

title: Eat basi bhojan
description: Eat the cold food as prasad; sprinkle Sheetla Mata water on children.

title: Day 1 onward
description: From the day after Holi, girls bring fresh barley (jwara), clay Isar-Gauri idols and sing folk songs daily for 16-18 days.

title: Daily puja
description: Offer durva, flowers, haldi, kumkum and water to Gauri each morning.

title: Final day
description: Women dress in shringar with mehendi and offer ghevar and gunje; evening procession with decorated Gauri idols.

title: Visarjan
description: Immerse the idols or jwara in a pond or well with songs.

title: Morning bath and fast
description: Bathe, clean the puja corner and take the sankalp for the vrat.

title: Midday birth puja
description: At Madhyahna perform Ram Janma: abhishek of Ram Darbar with panchamrit, tulsi leaves, offering panakam/panjiri.

title: Path and bhajan
description: Recite Ramcharitmanas, Ram Raksha Stotra or Sundarkand and sing aarti.

title: Parana
description: Break the fast the next morning after Dashami with Brahmin or kanya bhojan.

title: Bath and sankalp
description: Bathe at dawn, clean the Hanuman murti or visit the temple.

title: Chola and puja
description: Apply jasmine oil with sindoor to the idol, offer red flowers, janeu, tulsi and laddu/boondi.

title: Path
description: Recite Hanuman Chalisa 11 times or Sundarkand and perform aarti.

title: Bhandara
description: Distribute prasad or hold a community bhandara.

title: Fast and sankalp
description: Take sankalp in the morning; fast with fruits and water or fully nirjala.

title: First prahar abhishek
description: Bathe the Shivling with water and milk, offer bel patra and dhatura chanting Om Namah Shivaya.

title: Second to fourth prahar
description: Abhishek with curd (2nd), ghee (3rd) and honey (4th) as per the four-prahar tradition; keep a night-long jagran.

title: Parana
description: Break the fast next morning after sunrise with prasad.

title: Holy bath
description: Take a bath before sunrise, ideally with a few sesame seeds in the water or at a holy river.

title: Surya arghya
description: Offer water in a copper lota to the Sun with red flowers and chant Surya mantras.

title: Daan
description: Donate til, jaggery, khichdi ingredients, blankets and warm clothes to the needy.

title: Kite flying and food
description: Eat til-gud, khichdi and ghevar; fly kites with family.

title: Yellow setup
description: Wear yellow, clean the puja space and place the Saraswati image with books and instruments.

title: Saraswati puja
description: Offer yellow flowers, roli, haldi, kesari bhaat; keep pen and books for blessing.

title: Vidyarambh
description: Children are guided to write their first letters on rice or slate.

title: Prasad
description: Distribute kesari bhaat and boondi.

title: Morning bath
description: Bathe, wear clean clothes and take sankalp.

title: Lakshmi-Vishnu puja
description: Worship Vishnu and Lakshmi with tulsi, yellow flowers, barley and sattu.

title: Buy and give
description: Buy gold or silver (optional), start new work, and donate water pots, fans, sattu, barley or clothes.

title: Parana (Jain)
description: Jains break the year-long Varshi Tap with sugarcane juice.

title: Check Bhadra Kaal
description: Choose a rakhi time outside Bhadra Kaal.

title: Prepare the thali
description: Sister arranges the rakhi, roli, akshat, diya, sweets and coconut in a thali.

title: Tie rakhi
description: Tilak, tie rakhi on the right wrist, aarti and feed sweets; brother touches elders' feet if needed.

title: Gift and vow
description: Brother gives a gift and pledges protection.

title: Fast and decorate
description: Fast during the day and decorate the home mandir with a jhula and flowers.

title: Midnight janma
description: At midnight bathe Laddu Gopal with panchamrit, dress him, place him in the jhula and (in many homes) cut a cucumber symbolically for the birth.

title: Bhog and aarti
description: Offer makhan-mishri, panjiri, tulsi and ring the bell; sing Krishna aarti.

title: Parana
description: Break the fast after the midnight puja; next day Dahi Handi and Nandotsav celebrations.

title: Sand idol
description: Prepare Shiva-Parvati idols from sand or clay, decorate with flowers and a chunri.

title: Evening puja
description: Offer bel patra, flowers and shringar items to Parvati and listen to the katha.

title: Night jagran
description: Women stay awake singing bhajans.

title: Parana
description: Break the fast next morning after puja.

title: Green shringar
description: Apply mehendi and wear green sarees, bangles and a bindi; decorate the swing with flowers.

title: Teej Mata puja
description: Worship Shiva-Parvati or Teej Mata with sindoor, fruits and sweets and read the Teej katha.

title: Swings and songs
description: Women sing Teej songs on swings, gift sindhara to daughters and share ghevar.

title: Naga puja
description: Offer milk, haldi, roli and flowers to a snake image, a Naga murti or a snake pit and recite Naga mantras.

title: Observe restrictions
description: Avoid digging, cutting vegetables and frying on this day.

title: Guru puja
description: Wash the guru's padukas or picture, offer flowers, fruits and dakshina and seek blessings.

title: Vyasa puja
description: Worship Veda Vyasa and read excerpts from Mahabharata or Vedas.

title: Seva
description: Do daan and satsang.

title: Holy dip
description: Take a dip in the Ganga or any river at sunrise, chanting 'Om Namo Gange'.

title: Ganga aarti and daan
description: Light diyas and donate water pots, sherbet, fans and fruits.

title: Sankalp
description: On Dashami eat lightly; on Ekadashi morning take sankalp to fast without water.

title: Vishnu puja
description: Worship Vishnu with tulsi leaves and yellow flowers and recite Vishnu Sahasranama.

title: Daan
description: Donate water pots, fans, clothes and sherbet.

title: Parana
description: Break the fast the next morning after sunrise in the parana window.

title: Fast prep
description: Prepare puja thali with fruits, kachcha soot, roli, chana and fan.

title: Vat puja
description: Offer water, roli, akshat and fruits to the banyan tree and tie raw thread 7 or 108 times around it.

title: Katha
description: Listen to the Savitri-Satyavan katha and pray for the husband's long life.

title: Parana
description: Break the fast after puja, and give a gift (bayana) to the mother-in-law.

title: Chariot pulling
description: Pahandi rituals, then devotees pull the chariots of Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra.

title: Prasad
description: Distribute mahaprasad.

title: Tool worship
description: Clean tools, machines and workplaces, place Vishwakarma's image and offer flowers, roli and sweets.

title: Prasad
description: Share prasad and community meals with workers.

title: Holy dip
description: Take a Kartik snan before sunrise in a holy river or pond (Pushkar, Ganga, Yamuna).

title: Deepdan
description: Light diyas at the ghats or home in the evening and float lamps in the river.

title: Satyanarayan katha
description: Perform Satyanarayan puja and katha and donate.

title: Prabhat pheri
description: Early morning kirtan processions through localities.

title: Akhand Path and nagar kirtan
description: Continuous recitation of Guru Granth Sahib and Nagar Kirtan procession.

title: Langar
description: Community meal with karah prasad.

title: Janma kalyanak abhishek
description: Abhishek of Mahavira's idol with pure water and milk, followed by shanti-dhara.

title: Rath yatra
description: Procession with Mahavira's idol, charity and sermons.

title: Temple and meditation
description: Visit Buddha viharas, offer flowers, lamps and incense, and meditate.

title: Charity
description: Donate food and clothes, and observe the Panchsheel.

title: Night puja
description: Offer a mustard-oil diya, black sesame, urad dishes and jalebi to Kal Bhairav; recite Bhairav Chalisa.

title: Feed dogs
description: Feed dogs and give daan to the poor.

title: Sita-Ram vivah
description: Decorate a picture of Sita-Ram, offer shringar and sweets, and sing wedding songs and recite Vivah Prasang of Ramcharitmanas.

title: Gita path
description: Recite the Bhagavad Gita or at least a few chapters and offer tulsi to Krishna.

title: Fast and charity
description: Observe the Ekadashi fast and donate.

title: Bonfire
description: Gather around the bonfire at sunset, circle it and offer popcorn, peanuts, sesame and revri.

title: Dance and food
description: Perform bhangra and enjoy sarson da saag, makki di roti and sweets.

title: Cooking Pongal
description: Boil milk and rice in a new pot in the courtyard and shout 'Pongalo Pongal' when it overflows; offer to the Sun on a banana leaf.

title: Mattu Pongal
description: Next day cattle are bathed, decorated and fed.

title: Pookalam and Onasadya
description: Make a floral carpet at the entrance and serve a banquet with banana leaf.

title: Celebrations
description: Join boat races, Pulikali, Kaikottikali.

title: Home cleaning
description: Clean the house, make rangoli and erect a gudi (flag) in some regions.

title: Panchang puja
description: Worship the new panchang, hear the year's forecast and eat neem-jaggery.

title: Start Navratri
description: Start Chaitra Navratri with Ghatasthapana.

title: Ghatasthapana
description: Set up the kalash and jwara at the muhurat and light Akhand Jyot.

title: Nine-day worship
description: Worship the nine Durga forms daily with fasting and recite Durga Saptashati.

title: Ram Navami
description: Conclude with Navami havan, kanya pujan and Ram Navami puja.

title: Dashami
description: Eat sattvic food once on Dashami (avoid grains and rice on Ekadashi).

title: Fast and puja
description: Worship Vishnu with tulsi, Panchamrit and yellow flowers; read the Ekadashi katha.

title: Parana
description: Break the fast next morning in the Parana window with grain food first offered to Vishnu.

title: Satyanarayan katha
description: Install Satyanarayan image on a chowki with banana pillars, perform kalash puja, read five chapters of the katha and offer sooji halwa and Panchamrit prasad.

title: Moon arghya
description: Offer arghya to the moon in the evening.

title: Tarpan and daan
description: Offer water with black sesame to ancestors, light a diya under a peepal tree, and donate food and clothes.

title: Shiva abhishek
description: At twilight perform abhishek with milk, curd, honey and gangajal, offer bel patra, light a diya and recite Shiva Chalisa and aarti.

title: Ganesh puja
description: Worship Ganesha with durva, modak and red flowers, and read the Sankashti katha.

title: Moon arghya
description: After moonrise offer arghya and break the fast.
